name: Table
purpose: Displays tabular data edge-to-edge — rows and columns of related records, e.g. a member list, a billing history.
import: import { Table, TableHead, TableBody, TableRow, TableHeaderCell, TableCell } from '@helixds/react';
neverUseFor: A single record's key/value details — use a description list pattern instead
Card-wrapped individual rows — Table rows are edge-to-edge by design, never wrap one row in a Card
Non-tabular free-form content — Table is for genuinely row/column data, not a generic layout grid
rationale: Table renders native <table> tags to ensure tabular WCAG accessibility semantics (th scope, caption, tr/td navigation). Rows expand 100% edge-to-edge inside their parent container.

mayExtendLocally: Compose custom cell renderers using Helix Badge, Avatar, or IconButton
Implement client-side or server-side pagination controls below the Table
mustEscalateToDS: Modifying internal row padding or border tokens
Replacing native HTML <table> with flex/grid div rows

anatomy.description: Root — always a native <table>, always 100% width of its container.
One row. Hover is CSS-only (:hover), never a JS mouseenter/mouseleave handler.
One data cell — content is fully consumer-controlled (text, Badge, Avatar, Button, ...).

props.name: children
props.description: Table content — typically a TableHead and a TableBody.

a11y.role: table (implicit — native <table>/<thead>/<tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td> already carries full table semantics, nothing hand-rolled)

properties.name: state
properties.description: On the TableRow set only — :hover in code fills the body row with fill/secondary/interactive/default.

properties.name: label
properties.description: TableHeaderCell's text (Label / Uppercase, uppercased + letterSpacing wide at the call site).

figma.structure: Three building blocks — TableHeaderCell, TableCell (components) and TableRow (set: state) — composed into a static Table component. The last body row's instance drops its bottom stroke, like `:last-child { border-bottom: none }` in code.
